failures: Wiley Scholar Gateway free-tier quota exhausted (getUsageLimit: 30/30 queries used, 0 remaining, resets 2026-11-01). Of the planned sweep of at least 14 natural-language questions on gross anatomy and histology/ultrastructure/histochemistry of the paraphysis, only 8 were attempted (all in one parallel batch) and every one returned type=free_tier_limit_reached with result_count 0; no search was executed. No year-window variants were run. No Wiley passages or Wiley metadata were obtained, so no record in this file comes from Wiley. No workaround was used to obtain Wiley content.

Because the Wiley channel was unavailable, a limited PubMed fallback (17 queries, permitted by the task text as an available channel) was run on the same anatomy/histology topics. It surfaced 96 distinct PMIDs, of which 94 were already held by other agents; only 2 are new and both are peripheral (dorsal sac, not paraphysis proper).
One PubMed fallback query (anatomy/morphology/histology plus 'lamina') returned 36891 irrelevant hits and was discarded unscreened.

records.title: Immunolocalization of exoglycoproteins ("ependymins") in the goldfish brain.
records.authors: Lakos SF, Thormodsson FR, Grafstein B

records.excerpt: The choroid plexus, saccus dorsalis, the roof of the third ventricle and Reissner's fiber showed strong immunostaining.
records.note: Goldfish: ependymin-type exoglycoprotein immunostaining of the saccus dorsalis and choroid plexus; adjacent-structure histochemistry, no paraphysis data.

records.title: The distribution of vasotocin and isotocin in the brain of the rainbow trout.
records.authors: Van den Dungen HM, Buijs RM, Pool CW, Terlou M
records.query: ("dorsal sac" OR "saccus dorsalis" OR "velum transversum") AND (paraphysis OR telencephalon OR pineal OR "choroid plexus")
records.excerpt: The area dorsalis pars medialis of the telencephalon, the saccus dorsalis, and the basal part of the nucleus recessus posterioris were found to be innervated by vasotocin and scarcely by isotocin fibers.
records.note: Rainbow trout: neuropeptidergic (vasotocin) innervation of the saccus dorsalis, the paraphysis-neighbouring dorsal sac; adjacent-structure innervation data only.
